motive.zhHans: 至于动机，Kenya 之所以抛弃 Waka，是因为他开始与一个有钱的女孩交往，而 Waka 威胁 Kenya，要把他的旧日所作所为一五一十地告诉这个女孩。
motive.en: As for the motive, Kenya had dumped Waka because he was starting to date a rich girl, and Waka threatened Kenya to reveal all his former deeds to this girl.

method.zhHans: 他在小兰进入房间前 30 分钟就杀了 Waka，用毛巾裹住她的头、给她戴上口罩，然后在浴室里散播氯仿。几天前，他还设法让 Rumi 在一只瓶子上留下指纹——那只瓶子看上去就是装氯仿的瓶子，后来被警方找到。
method.en: He killed Waka 30 minutes before Ran came into her room, put a towel around her head and a face mask on her, then spread chloroform in the bathroom. A few days before, he had ensured Rumi had left her fingerprints on a bottle, which appeared to be the bottle containing the chloroform which was found by the police.
method.replacedEn: All this led Masumi Sera to point Rumi as the culprit (as Kenya had foreseen that): the towel and the face mask would lead Ran to doubt if she really saw Waka, or if it was not rather Rumi who had disguised herself in Waka - then, after Ran had collapsed, she would have really killed Waka and put them in the bathroom as if she had been there from the beginning. But Conan declares that this trick was way too inconsistent; he also notices that Kenya has been shown to have a bad sight (being unable to put objects at the right place, etc.), and that it may be due to the disappearing of one of his eyes contacts. After the case resolution, Eri Kisaki declares that, earlier, she has seen Masumi calling someone with her phone, a person who, according to the wording she used, would be her brother.

evidence.zhHans: 几天前，他已设法让 Rumi 在一个瓶子上留下指纹，而这个瓶子看来正是警方找到的、装有三氯甲烷的那个瓶子。因此，只要掰开她闭着的那只眼，就能证明 Kenya 就是凶手：他的指纹仍会留在那片隐形眼镜上。
evidence.en: A few days before, he had ensured Rumi had left her fingerprints on a bottle, which appeared to be the bottle containing the chloroform which was found by the police. By opening her closed eye, it could be therefore proved that Kenya was the murderer: his fingerprints would still be on the eye contact.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Kenya Settsu。他在毛利兰进入 Waka 房间的 30 分钟前杀害了 Waka，把毛巾缠在她头上、给她戴上口罩，然后在浴室里散播三氯甲烷。几天前，他已设法让 Rumi 在一个瓶子上留下指纹，而这个瓶子看来正是警方找到的、装有三氯甲烷的那个瓶子。这一切让世良真纯指认 Rumi 就是犯人（正如 Kenya 所预判）：那条毛巾和那只口罩会让毛利兰怀疑自己是否真的见到了 Waka，或者那其实不是 Rumi 假扮成 Waka——那么，在毛利兰昏倒之后，她就会真的杀死 Waka，并把 Waka 与这些物件一并安置在浴室里，仿佛她从一开始就在那里。但江户川柯南指出，这个诡计实在太不连贯；他还注意到，Kenya 一直被表现为视力很差（无法把物体放到正确的位置等），而这可能是因为他的一片隐形眼镜不见了。那片隐形眼镜其实是在他与 Waka 搏斗时脱落的，而 Waka 在昏过去之前把它捡起来、戴到自己眼上，然后闭上了眼睛，这就解释了她为什么一直在眨眼。因此，只要掰开她闭着的那只眼，就能证明 Kenya 就是凶手：他的指纹仍会留在那片隐形眼镜上。
resolution.en: The culprit is Kenya Settsu. He killed Waka 30 minutes before Ran came into her room, put a towel around her head and a face mask on her, then spread chloroform in the bathroom. A few days before, he had ensured Rumi had left her fingerprints on a bottle, which appeared to be the bottle containing the chloroform which was found by the police. All this led Masumi Sera to point Rumi as the culprit (as Kenya had foreseen that): the towel and the face mask would lead Ran to doubt if she really saw Waka, or if it was not rather Rumi who had disguised herself in Waka - then, after Ran had collapsed, she would have really killed Waka and put them in the bathroom as if she had been there from the beginning. But Conan declares that this trick was way too inconsistent; he also notices that Kenya has been shown to have a bad sight (being unable to put objects at the right place, etc.), and that it may be due to the disappearing of one of his eyes contacts. This eye contact had actually been lost when he was fighting with Waka, and before passing out, she had collected it and put it on her own eye, before closing it, which explains why she was winking. By opening her closed eye, it could be therefore proved that Kenya was the murderer: his fingerprints would still be on the eye contact.

summary.en: As Conan and Ran are waiting for a meeting with Eri, they meet Masumi, who is investigating Rumi Kitao's boyfriend, Kenya Settsu, about adultery. Thinking that Kenya will make a move upon seeing Ran, Masumi has Conan and Ran approach the couple upon the pretense of needing a meal. However, Kenya doesn't seem to be interested in Ran and asks Ran to accompany Rumi to wake Waka, Kenya's ex-girlfriend. Rumi and Ran has to open Waka's apartment with a key when no one answers.

suspects: Rumi Kitao, Kenya Settsu, and Mitsuaki Kaga
